description: This file defines a React context and provider for managing a Kanban board's state, including fetching, real-time updates, and CRUD operations for columns and cards, integrating with a Supabase backend.

methods.name: useKanban()
methods.description: Custom hook to access Kanban context.

methods.name: KanbanProvider({ children })
methods.description: React component providing Kanban state and operations via context.

methods.name: fetchAll
methods.description: Fetches all columns and cards data from the backend.

methods.name: addColumn
methods.description: Adds a new column with a given title.

methods.name: updateColumn
methods.description: Updates an existing column identified by id.

methods.name: reorderColumns
methods.description: Reorders columns based on provided list.

methods.name: addCard
methods.description: Adds a new card to a specified column.

methods.name: deleteCard
methods.description: Deletes a card by id with optimistic UI update.

methods.name: reorderCardsInColumn
methods.description: Reorders cards within a specific column.

methods.name: bulkInsertCards
methods.description: Inserts multiple cards into a column in bulk.
